content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents, then read_document on candidate_specs.md and any environmental/safety policy documents to extract the three allowed gas mixtures and identify which candidates comply with laboratory environmental and safety requirements."},{"id":"s2","description":"For each compliant candidate mixture, run simulate_time_resolution at representative gas gaps spanning the allowed 1–3 mm range, including at least 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0 mm; record the numeric time-resolution results with record_results."},{"id":"s3","description":"Identify the mixture and gap region with the lowest simulated time resolution from the coarse scan, then run additional simulate_time_resolution points around that minimum with finer gap spacing while staying within 1–3 mm; record all numeric results."},{"id":"s4","description":"Check whether the best-performing simulated option is from an allowed candidate mixture and remains compliant with the environmental and safety policies; if not, select the best compliant alternative from the recorded results."},{"id":"s5","description":"Prepare the final numeric evidence for the reporting module: the recommended mixture candidate index or identifier if numeric, the recommended gas gap in mm, the achieved simulated time resolution in ns, and the key comparison values needed to justify the choice."}]}
